pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Menu Button and Menu (actions menu) with submenus; roving focus with real DOM focus on items.

aria.value: "true" while the corresponding menu is open
Trigger id by default; the label option sets aria-label instead
"true"; the item stays focusable but is not activatable

keyboard.action: Opens the menu and focuses the first enabled item.
Opens the menu and focuses the last enabled item.
Next / previous item, wrapping. Disabled items receive focus.
Focus the next item whose label starts with the typed characters.
Activates the item (emits aui-select and closes), toggles a checkbox or checks a radio, or opens a submenu.
Same as Enter; with closeOnSelect=false, toggles checkbox/radio items without closing.
Opens the submenu and focuses its first item.
Closes the submenu and returns focus to its parent item.
Closes that submenu only and returns focus to its parent item.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger; an enclosing Dialog stays open.
Closes all levels; focus moves to the next/previous element from the trigger.

focus: Real DOM focus moves to items (tabindex -1) and follows the pointer on hover. Focused items show a background; keyboard focus adds a color-focus-ring outline (:focus-visible). Activation, Escape at the top level, and close() with focus inside return focus to the trigger.
notes: Disabled items stay focusable, per the APG, so screen-reader users discover them.
The shortcut hint is exposed as a description, not as part of the item name.
Each level is a separate overlay-stack entry, so Escape and outside presses close the topmost level first.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
